{{Top|leg}}
'''Skreeka''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. It was not nearly as large as [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]], just to the southeast. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], just before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]] [[Gotal hostage standoff|hostage crisis]].
